note: SYNTHETIC SELFTEST FIXTURE — NOT A RETIREMENT ROW. This ledger exists so the retirement gate can be shown to ALLOW a fully satisfied family through the real CLI, with evidence that is really committed (a cold clone can read every pointer). The family is named `synthetic-selftest` on purpose: no production family may ever be retired by pointing at this file, and the production ledger (dev/agent-workflow/ledgers/ute-retirement.json) does not import it. The evidence is deliberately trivial; what is being exercised is the gate's evidence path, not a tool family. Its `unit.familyId` borrows the test-only ARC-A probe family (`dsh.u6-probe-family`, one member) because the unit must be derived from the reviewed census: a synthetic family that booked no census entry would (correctly) be refused UTE_UNIT_UNKNOWN_FAMILY. The approval reference points at the commit that introduced this fixture, a real ancestor of the graded HEAD.
